lead_raw_text:
The structure of Tb₂Mg₁₄Ag₂ (TbMg₇Ag) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6₃/mmc (No. 194), with 18 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows all Ag, Mg, and Tb centers adopt close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors, with neighbor distances ranging from about 3.13 to 3.43 Å. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 18 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include Mg–Mg 12-vertex polyhedra with corner, edge, and face sharing, while Ag–Mg and Tb–Mg pairs show corner and edge sharing.
